results.title: An Investigation into LLM Vulnerabilities Using Situational Context
results.content: # Title:Human-Readable Adversarial Prompts: An Investigation into LLM Vulnerabilities Using Situational Context. View a PDF of the paper titled Human-Readable Adversarial Prompts: An Investigation into LLM Vulnerabilities Using Situational Context, by Nilanjana Das and 3 other authors. > Abstract:As the AI systems become deeply embedded in social media platforms, we've uncovered a concerning security vulnerability that goes beyond traditional adversarial attacks. Unlike obvious nonsensical text strings that safety systems can easily catch, our work reveals that human-readable situation-driven adversarial full-prompts that leverage situational context are effective but much harder to detect. Second, we developed a method to transform gibberish adversarial text into readable, innocuous content that still exploits vulnerabilities when used within the full-prompts. |  | (or  arXiv:2412.16359v3 [cs.CL] for this version) |.
